; PROBE (temporary): F4/R1 — does lightSleepDelay>0 make requestSleep() pass
; through LIGHT sleep (0->1->2) instead of jumping straight to deep (0->2)?
; And what governs the 1->2 timing: lightSleepDelay or deepSleepDelay?
; Polls /tmp/sleeptest.cmd every 2s; acts on a NEW command string (prefix match):
;   status          -> log all delay values + current state
;   setlight:<ms>   -> BatteryManager.lightSleepDelay = ms (logs read-back)
;   setdeep:<ms>    -> BatteryManager.deepSleepDelay  = ms (logs read-back)
;   requestsleep    -> BatteryManager.requestSleep()
;   restorevals     -> restore both delays to startup values
;   introspect      -> enumerate all BatteryManager members (find hidden APIs)
;   foliotrue       -> BatteryManager.folioClosed = true (readback; light sleep?)
;   foliofalse      -> BatteryManager.folioClosed = false
;   wake:<n>        -> BatteryManager.onWakeup(n)  (n = WakeupReason enum, try 0..)
;   armbounce:<n>   -> next 0->2 transition: call onWakeup(n) synchronously in the
;                      handler (does it cancel sleep BEFORE the sleep window flashes?)
;   buttonsim       -> full pipeline rehearsal: requestSleep -> bounce(5) ->
;                      600ms -> rm-shot /tmp/buttonsim.png -> 1400ms -> requestSleep
;                      (second one goes deep for real; wake with wake:5)
; Trigger:  ssh root@10.11.99.1 'echo "setlight:1500 #1" > /tmp/sleeptest.cmd'
; (trailing #N makes each command unique)

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: lsdProbe
				visible: false

				property string lastCmd: ""
				property real origLight: -1
				property real origDeep: -1
				property int bounceReason: -1
				property bool simActive: false

				XoviMessageBroker { id: lsdBroker }

				Timer {
					id: simShot
					interval: 600
					onTriggered: {
						lsdBroker.sendSimpleSignal("takeScreenshot", "/tmp/buttonsim.png,0");
						console.log("LSDPROBE sim shot fired t=" + Date.now());
					}
				}
				Timer {
					id: simResleep
					interval: 1400
					onTriggered: {
						lsdProbe.simActive = false;
						console.log("LSDPROBE sim resleep t=" + Date.now());
						BatteryManager.requestSleep();
					}
				}

				function act(cmd) {
					console.log("LSDPROBE act '" + cmd + "' state=" + BatteryManager.displayState
						+ " t=" + Date.now());
					try {
						if (cmd.indexOf("status") === 0) {
							console.log("LSDPROBE status lightSleepDelay=" + BatteryManager.lightSleepDelay
								+ " deepSleepDelay=" + BatteryManager.deepSleepDelay
								+ " displayState=" + BatteryManager.displayState
								+ " lightSleepEnabled=" + Settings.lightSleepEnabled);
						} else if (cmd.indexOf("setlight:") === 0) {
							BatteryManager.lightSleepDelay = parseInt(cmd.substring(9), 10);
							console.log("LSDPROBE lightSleepDelay readback=" + BatteryManager.lightSleepDelay);
						} else if (cmd.indexOf("setdeep:") === 0) {
							BatteryManager.deepSleepDelay = parseInt(cmd.substring(8), 10);
							console.log("LSDPROBE deepSleepDelay readback=" + BatteryManager.deepSleepDelay);
						} else if (cmd.indexOf("requestsleep") === 0) {
							BatteryManager.requestSleep();
						} else if (cmd.indexOf("introspect") === 0) {
							var out = [];
							for (var k in BatteryManager)
								out.push(k + ":" + (typeof BatteryManager[k] === "function"
									? "fn" : typeof BatteryManager[k] + "=" + BatteryManager[k]));
							console.log("LSDPROBE introspect " + out.join(" | "));
						} else if (cmd.indexOf("foliotrue") === 0) {
							BatteryManager.folioClosed = true;
							console.log("LSDPROBE folioClosed readback=" + BatteryManager.folioClosed);
						} else if (cmd.indexOf("foliofalse") === 0) {
							BatteryManager.folioClosed = false;
							console.log("LSDPROBE folioClosed readback=" + BatteryManager.folioClosed);
						} else if (cmd.indexOf("wake:") === 0) {
							BatteryManager.onWakeup(parseInt(cmd.substring(5), 10));
							console.log("LSDPROBE onWakeup called, state=" + BatteryManager.displayState);
						} else if (cmd.indexOf("armbounce:") === 0) {
							lsdProbe.bounceReason = parseInt(cmd.substring(10), 10);
							console.log("LSDPROBE bounce armed, reason=" + lsdProbe.bounceReason);
						} else if (cmd.indexOf("buttonsim") === 0) {
							lsdProbe.simActive = true;
							lsdProbe.bounceReason = 5;
							BatteryManager.requestSleep();
						} else if (cmd.indexOf("restorevals") === 0) {
							BatteryManager.lightSleepDelay = lsdProbe.origLight;
							BatteryManager.deepSleepDelay = lsdProbe.origDeep;
							console.log("LSDPROBE restored light=" + BatteryManager.lightSleepDelay
								+ " deep=" + BatteryManager.deepSleepDelay);
						} else {
							console.log("LSDPROBE unknown cmd");
						}
					} catch (e) {
						console.log("LSDPROBE call failed: " + e);
					}
				}

				Timer {
					interval: 2000
					repeat: true
					running: true
					onTriggered: {
						var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
						xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
							if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
							var cmd = (xhr.responseText || "").trim();
							if (cmd === "" || cmd === lsdProbe.lastCmd) return;
							lsdProbe.lastCmd = cmd;
							lsdProbe.act(cmd);
						};
						xhr.open("GET", "file:///tmp/sleeptest.cmd");
						xhr.send();
					}
				}

				Connections {
					target: BatteryManager
					ignoreUnknownSignals: true
					function onDisplayStateChanged(previous, next) {
						console.log("LSDPROBE displayState " + previous + " -> " + next
							+ " t=" + Date.now());
						if (lsdProbe.bounceReason >= 0 && previous === 0 && next === 2) {
							var r = lsdProbe.bounceReason;
							lsdProbe.bounceReason = -1;
							try {
								BatteryManager.onWakeup(r);
								console.log("LSDPROBE bounce onWakeup(" + r + ") state now="
									+ BatteryManager.displayState + " t=" + Date.now());
								if (lsdProbe.simActive) { simShot.start(); simResleep.start(); }
							} catch (e) {
								console.log("LSDPROBE bounce failed: " + e);
							}
						}
					}
					function onSuspending() { console.log("LSDPROBE suspending t=" + Date.now()); }
					function onResumed() { console.log("LSDPROBE resumed t=" + Date.now()); }
					function onWokeUp() { console.log("LSDPROBE wokeUp t=" + Date.now()); }
				}

				Component.onCompleted: {
					origLight = BatteryManager.lightSleepDelay;
					origDeep = BatteryManager.deepSleepDelay;
					console.log("LSDPROBE ready. lightSleepDelay=" + origLight
						+ " deepSleepDelay=" + origDeep
						+ " state=" + BatteryManager.displayState);
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
